title: Restore a pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence
summary: You can apply to restore your pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence if it has expired within the last three months by visiting a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If your pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence has expired within the last 3 months, you can apply to have it restored. You can do this at a Service NSW Centre.

If you do not apply to restore your licence within 3 months, you'll need to apply for a new licence. You cannot trade until the new licence is issued.
who_can_apply: Your pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence must have expired within the last 3 months.

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and provide the information in person.

faqs.q: How long do I have to restore my licence?
faqs.a: You must apply to restore your licence within 3 months of it expiring. If you do not apply within 3 months, you will need to apply for a new licence.

faqs.q: What happens if I don't restore my licence in time?
faqs.a: If you do not restore your licence within 3 months, you must apply for a new licence. You cannot trade until the new licence is issued.

faqs.q: How do I restore my licence?
faqs.a: Visit a Service NSW Centre and provide the required information in person.
